text:
anna: Heads up — planning to decommission per-tenant edge proxies and consolidate to regional shared-relay pools. Putting a phased plan + ops checklist here, want any objections or missing blockers before we schedule.

mike: +1 high-level please — what's the rollback story if a tenant sees a traffic spike or auth issue?

anna: Phase sketch:
1) Provision relay pools per-region with routing tags and tenant metadata.
2) Mirror traffic (observe only) for 24h.
3) Canary: shift 10% of tenant traffic to relay; monitor.
4) Ramp to 50% -> 100% if metrics good.
5) Revoke private endpoint and remove tenant proxy once stable for 72h.

sarah: Quick DNS note: set DNS TTL to 60s before canary. Keep old endpoints live for at least 24h after any rollback window so customers with slow caches are covered.

javier: SNAT/Source-IP question: customers rely on source IP for allowlists. Relay NATs — do we have a plan to preserve client IP or signal it upstream?

kevin: We can emit X-Forwarded-For but that won't satisfy allowlists. Proposal: maintain a small SNAT pool per-tenant during cutover and advertise those addresses to customers for a transition period.

anna: Ops checklist (first draft):
``` 
- provision relays (regional, size pairs)
- deploy routing rules + tenant tag mapping
- create traffic-mirroring rule (observe only)
- validate TLS cert chain and client SNI passthrough
- enable 10% canary, monitor for 2h
- escalate if >0.5% error increase or 95p latency > target
- ramp 50% then 100% after 48h stable
- revoke private endpoint, remove proxy, update docs
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: relay/provisioning -> staging @anna

mike: Monitoring/KPIs to track during canary: per-tenant 95p latency, request error rate, authentication failures, token generation latency, token cost variance. Alerting thresholds: errors >0.5% or latency regressed >15%.

sarah: Add synthetic checks: DNS propagation time, TLS handshake error rate, TCP RST count. Also add a datapoint for connection reuse (keepalive) since relays change path.

anna: Rollback plan: flip routing tag back to tenant proxy, keep relay running for forensic + soak, revert any SNAT pool advertising, and restore peering if we removed it. Manual rollback gated by two SRE approvals or one oncall + product lead.

javier: Compliance note: do NOT revoke private endpoint until audit logs for that endpoint are archived for 7 days (legal requirement for certain customers). Add to cutover gating.

kevin: I'll prepare an emergency iptables/route patch we can push during cutover if we detect packet loss to upstream services.

anna: Timeline proposal: staging dry-run on Thu; week 1: 10% canary for selected tenants; week 2: 50% for all queued tenants; week 3: full removal and postmortem. Oncall coverage: sarah + javier first 48h after 50% ramp.

sarah: I'll draft the runbook (playbooks for cert renewal fail, peering flap, dns mismatch), and owner list. Will link GH issue shortly.

mike: :thumbsup: assign owners in GH and calendar invite for dry-run. Also coordinate sales/customer success for tenants with strict allowlists.

anna: Thanks — tagging action items: @mike monitoring dashboards, @kevin SNAT plan & iptable patch, @sarah runbook + alerts, @javier compliance gating. If no blockers by Wed EOD I'll schedule the dry-run.
